# Sudip Niroula

> Full-stack software engineer based in Birtamod, Nepal. Builds and ships
> production web applications end to end, mostly Python and FastAPI on the
> backend with Next.js on the front. Open to remote work.

Contact: sudipniroula5@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/imsudip45
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/sudipniroula45

## Current role

Full-Stack Developer at Nullion Technologies (April 2026 to present). Previously
Software Engineer at FutureFrame (February 2025 to March 2026), building real-time
data pipelines for live broadcast products at sub-second latency.

## Education

BSc in Computer Science and Information Technology, Mechi Multiple Campus,
Tribhuvan University, Nepal (2022 to 2026).

## Technologies

Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, SQL, FastAPI, Django REST Framework,
Next.js, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, Google Cloud, Electron,
PySide6, Flutter, WebSockets, LangChain, Gemini API.

## Projects

- [AlignCare Hub](https://aligncarehub.com/): multi-tenant operations console for
  US home-care agencies. FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL.
- [Ohio WebCheck Scheduler](https://fingerprint.nulliontech.com/): booking system
  for Ohio BCI and FBI fingerprint background checks, live availability across
  four locations, no account required.
- [Zoe's Beer](https://zoesbeer.com/): craft beer marketplace with inventory
  management.
- [Cafe 8848](https://cafe8848pa.com/): ordering and loyalty platform for a coffee
  shop in Brentwood, Pennsylvania, shipped as native iOS and Android apps.
- [Rustle](https://github.com/imsudip45/rustle): Windows search launcher written
  in Rust. Fuzzy matching via SkimMatcherV2, parallel indexing with Rayon,
  roughly 150ms startup scan.
- [Labhya Compute](https://github.com/imsudip45/Labya_compute): decentralized GPU
  compute marketplace with containerized SSH access and a relay server routing
  requests between providers and renters. Winner, Most Innovative Project,
  Ambition Hackathon 2025.
- [Fingerprint](https://github.com/imsudip45/Fingerprint): real-time multimodal AI
  tutor for children built on Gemini Live, with a backend planner that decides
  what to show, quiz, search, or teach from an uploaded worksheet.
- [LiteRT.js Classifier](https://imsudip45.github.io/litert-image-classifier/):
  in-browser image classification on WebGPU with a live GPU versus CPU latency
  benchmark.
- Football Score Pro: match management system, PySide6 desktop app with a React
  control room and FastAPI backend, built with dependency injection and an event
  bus. Private repository.
- Football Score Lite: broadcast graphics control for streamed matches. PIXI.js
  renderers usable as OBS browser sources, synchronized over WebSockets. Private
  repository.

## Writing

- [Token-Efficient Extraction of Text from Screenshots](https://www.sudipniroula.com.np/notes/token-efficient-screenshot-extraction.html):
  a survey of the gap between visual-token-compression research and exact text
  extraction, with a small pilot benchmark.
